baselineAtZero: A bordered, square, flat, fully usable control on a cream ground with a visible 3px focus outline. Doc §12 identifies this as neubrutalism's own minimalism fallback: the style is flat design plus a border and an offset, and dialling both to their floor lands exactly here.

shadowOffset.emitAs: integer px — round the resolved value at emit time
shadowOffset.note: Doc §13: linear, integer-rounded, 4px at 50. The contract carries the unrounded curve (5.6 at the default 60) and the skill rounds to 6px when it writes --nb-sx / --nb-sy, because rounding inside the curve would make the monotonicity sweep read a staircase where the doc states a line. At 0 the set switches to §8's named .nb--flat fallback: border only, no shadow.

borderWidth.note: Doc §13: stepped 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 at 0 / 25 / 50 / 75 / 100. Plateaus encode the hold; the 0.1-wide ramps sit below each boundary so no integer intensity lands inside one.

radius.note: Doc §13: inverse linear, 5px at 50. Inverse but monotone — rule 1 permits this. 12px is the ceiling; at or above it this is claymorphism.

chroma.note: Doc §13: percentage of the source accent's OKLCH C, with L and H held so contrast never moves with the knob.

tilt.note: Doc §13: decorative badges and stickers only, never a focusable or an ancestor of one.

contextCaps.reason: Doc §9: dense product UI takes this style as an accent, not a skin. Doc §13 additionally hard-clamps shadowOffset to 4px, borderWidth to 2px and tilt to 0 under this scope; those three are applied by the skill after resolution and reported alongside the cap.

clampsNotExpressibleHere.shadowBlur: exactly 0, always — not a knob, an invariant
clampsNotExpressibleHere.shadowSpread: 0 except 1px on the xl and 2xl rungs
clampsNotExpressibleHere.note: These are style invariants rather than knob bounds: they constrain the emitted CSS, not the value of a knob, so ui-morphism-core:a11y-validate and ../skills/audit/references/checklist.md enforce them. Recorded here so the clamp table is readable as the complete list.
